card.name: Just before airport names or codes
card.fires_on: Words right before an airport is named or coded, such as the open parenthesis before an IATA code after a city in flight listings, or words leading into 'airport' in travel guides.

modes.label: Flight listing city codes
modes.description: The parenthesis or first letters of a three-letter airport code after a departure or arrival city.
